title: RPI vs Tulane: tuition, size, location
summary: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) versus Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane). Also searched as Tulane vs RPI. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute vs Tulane University of Louisiana (RPI vs Tulane) differ primarily in location, enrollment, and tuition costs. RPI is located in Troy, New York, while Tulane is situated in New Orleans, Louisiana. Both institutions are private nonprofit universities. RPI has an undergraduate enrollment of 5,714 students, whereas Tulane enrolls 7,767 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at RPI is $64,081, slightly lower than Tulane's in-state tuition of $68,678. These distinctions highlight differences in size, setting, and cost between the two universities.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: In the comparison of cost between Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute vs Tulane University of Louisiana (RPI vs Tulane), tuition fees are a significant factor. Both in-state and out-of-state tuition at RPI are $64,081, which is lower than Tulane's tuition of $68,678 for both in-state and out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at RPI is $23,750, whereas Tulane's median debt completers carry a slightly lower amount of $20,500. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution.
